newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Novo Q1 profits seen down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Novo Q1 profits seen down.

text.p: A Reuter consensus forecast of nine analysts sees Novo Nordisk announcing a higher operating result but slightly lower net profit when it publishes first quarter results on Wednesday.

The analysts predicted on average an operating result of 543 million crowns, compared to 510 million in the first three months of 1996, and profit after tax of 393 million crowns for the 1997 first quarter compared to 396 million the year before.
They forecast pre-tax profit of 546 million crowns, down from 557 million.

Novo's own forecasts for the first quarter are similar to the analysts' predictions, but it expects full year operating results and pre-tax profit to be 15 percent higher than in 1996. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
